"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Switch as SwitchPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/switch"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/*
 * Chrome Azure Switch — the signature control. A beveled metal rim frames a
 * glossy specular track; the inner surface swaps from dark steel (off) to azure
 * alloy (on). The thumb is a raised chrome knob with an inset top highlight, a
 * wet sheen across its crown, and a soft drop shadow. Faithful to the reference
 * toggle: rim → track → surface → knob.
 */

// Base UI className can be a state function; the wrapper feeds it to cn(), so
// narrow it to a plain string.
type SwitchProps = Omit<SwitchPrimitive.Root.Props, "className"> & {
  className?: string
}

const Switch = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, SwitchProps>(
  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
    <SwitchPrimitive.Root
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        "group/switch group relative inline-flex h-7 w-12 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full p-[0.0938rem]",
        "[background:var(--metal-rim)] [box-shadow:var(--shadow-rim)]",
        "transition-[box-shadow] duration-base",
        "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background",
        "data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:opacity-50",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {/* glossy specular track, visible as a thin ring around the surface */}
      <span
        aria-hidden
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-[0.0938rem] rounded-full [background:var(--metal-track)]"
      />
      {/* off surface (dark steel) */}
      <span
        aria-hidden
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-[0.1875rem] rounded-full [background:var(--surface-off)] transition-opacity duration-slow group-data-checked:opacity-0"
      />
      {/* on surface (azure alloy) */}
      <span
        aria-hidden
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-[0.1875rem] rounded-full [background:var(--surface-on)] opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-slow group-data-checked:opacity-100"
      />
      <SwitchPrimitive.Thumb
        className={cn(
          "pointer-events-none relative z-10 block h-5 w-5 overflow-hidden rounded-full",
          "[background:var(--knob-off)] [box-shadow:var(--shadow-knob)]",
          "translate-x-0.5 data-checked:translate-x-[1.375rem]",
          "data-checked:[background:var(--knob-on)]",
          "origin-left data-checked:origin-right rtl:origin-right rtl:data-checked:origin-left transition-[translate,scale,transform-origin,background-color,box-shadow] duration-[260ms,140ms,0ms,150ms,150ms] delay-[0ms,0ms,140ms,0ms,0ms] ease-out motion-safe:group-active/switch:scale-x-[1.18] motion-reduce:transition-none"
        )}
      >
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full [background:var(--gloss-top)]"
        />
      </SwitchPrimitive.Thumb>
    </SwitchPrimitive.Root>
  )
)
Switch.displayName = "Switch"

export { Switch }
